# Chintan Savaliya — Webflow & Framer Developer

> Chintan Savaliya is a freelance Webflow and Framer developer based globally, serving founders, product teams, and design agencies. He specializes in building high-quality marketing sites, CMS-powered blogs, scroll animations, and WordPress-to-Webflow migrations. His work is characterized by pixel-perfect execution, clean CMS architecture, and attention to the design details that make a site feel intentional.

## About

Chintan Savaliya builds websites that convert — using Webflow and Framer as his primary platforms. He works with early-stage startups, VC-backed companies, and design agencies as both a direct client partner and a white-label development resource. His background spans the full Webflow stack: design implementation, CMS architecture, GSAP animations, and technical SEO foundations.

Website: https://chintan.design

## Services

- **Webflow Development** — Custom Webflow sites from Figma designs, with CMS setup, SEO foundations, and animation polish. Primary keyword: "webflow developer". URL: https://chintan.design/services/webflow-development

- **Framer Development** — Custom Framer component development, interactive animations, and CMS-powered content. Primary keyword: "framer developer". URL: https://chintan.design/services/framer-development

- **WordPress to Webflow Migration** — Full migration service including content migration, 301 redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and DNS cutover support. Primary keyword: "wordpress to webflow migration". URL: https://chintan.design/services/wordpress-to-webflow

- **GSAP Web Animations** — Scroll-driven animations, page transitions, hover micro-interactions, and SVG path animations built with GSAP and ScrollTrigger. Primary keyword: "gsap webflow animations". URL: https://chintan.design/services/gsap-animations

- **CMS Architecture & Strategy** — Webflow CMS schema design, collection planning, editor experience optimization, and content governance documentation. Primary keyword: "webflow cms development". URL: https://chintan.design/services/cms-architecture

## Blog

Chintan writes about Webflow development, Framer, web animations, CMS strategy, and AI-assisted content workflows. The blog covers both technical tutorials and strategic guides for teams building on the Webflow stack.

Blog URL: https://chintan.design/blog

Topics covered:
- Webflow development techniques and CMS patterns
- GSAP and web animation implementation
- AI tools and workflows for content and development
- WordPress to Webflow migration guides
- Framer development and component patterns
